subject: Insurance
title: Health Exams and Underwriting
description: A micro-lesson that makes Health Exams and Underwriting usable.

hook.text: To buy a large life insurance policy, you'll take a medical exam.

buildup.text: Underwriters use the results to classify you: Preferred Plus, Preferred, Standard, or Substandard.

discovery.text: A 'Preferred Plus' rating means excellent health—and premiums 30-40% cheaper than Standard.

twist.text: Nicotine users pay 2-3 times more than non-smokers.

climax.text: Underwriting turns your body into a risk score. Every health metric—cholesterol, BMI, blood pressure—has a price tag.

punchline.text: Blood draw, urine test, price tag. Your body determines your premium.

quiz.question: How much more do smokers typically pay for life insurance?
